messages:
anya: Quick note: noticed a regression where tiny-prefix tenants flip owners rapidly after deploy.

noah: Any logs?

anya: short example:
```
[2026-07-10T09:12:34Z] prefix=teamX/id handoff:start owner=node-3 -> node-7
[2026-07-10T09:12:34Z] prefix=teamX/id demote:attempt score=0.18 threshold=0.2
[2026-07-10T09:12:34Z] prefix=teamX/id demote:committed owner=none
[2026-07-10T09:12:34Z] prefix=teamX/id handoff:commit owner=node-7
```

rui: Looks like demote wins before handoff commit lands. Two recent changes: optimistic handoff ack + lower demote threshold.

noah: Short-term: raise demote threshold on canary and monitor. Longer-term: define explicit handoff states so demote checks them.

anya: I'll flip threshold on canary and run the evict smoke.

rui: Proposal for contract: add `handoff_state` enum {started, accepted, committed} and prevent demote if state != committed for N ms. Also emit metric `demote_blocked_by_handoff`.

noah: Can we implement using a lightweight per-prefix epoch timestamp instead of state machine to avoid counters?

rui: Epoch works if we use generation ids we already track. We'll sketch both in RFC.

ci-bot: CI: evict-smoke (canary) queued -> https://ci/evict-smoke

anya: Action items: (1) flip canary demote threshold (in progress), (2) rui to sketch RFC and add metric, (3) noah to add log lines for handoff phases. Keep updates here.
